page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 64 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system architecture is x86_64, and it is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance type does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory-to-vCPU ratio make this instance suitable for workloads that require large memory footprints without the overhead of shared-core resource contention. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise applications, and memory-intensive data processing tasks.
